title: how-it-works.md says an over-bound transfer fee is 'flagged, not refused'; configuration.md and the options page refuse it
claim: docs/how-it-works.md says a fee component above the plausibility bound (10 SEK/kWh) 'is flagged, not refused' and the plan runs on what you configured. docs/configuration.md's Time-of-use fee rules row says such a rate 'is refused when the page is saved', and the validator grid_fee.spec_problem returns grid_fee_rules_implausible for all three probes, the doc's own 100x-slip example (= 25) included. A capacity/fee reader gets opposite answers; the 'flagged' path holds only for values that bypass the page (a live sensor, a stored entry).

evidence.contention_note: fan-out: other seats running concurrently; counts are contention-immune

metric_definition: Over-bound rule texts for which the options-page validator refuses the save.
phenomenon_property: Each doc that says what happens to an over-bound fee distinguishes the page's refusal (rules) from the runtime flag (live sensor, stored values), as grid_fee does.
proposed_fix_scope: Docs only: say rules above the bound are refused on save; the repair-issue flag applies to a live fee sensor or a value stored before the check.
